targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	MAX(time) AS time,
	MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'cold-level-tank1' THEN level END) AS tank1,
	MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'cold-level-tank2' THEN level END) AS tank2
FROM (
	SELECT DISTINCT ON (technical_name)
		timestamp      AS time,
		technical_name AS name,
		level__value   AS level
	FROM public.marpower__fresh_water__level_sensors
	WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
	ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC
)

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank_1_fr_45_ps_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS fresh_water_tank_1_level_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank_2_fr_45_sb_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS fresh_water_tank_2_level_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-fresh-water'

SELECT
	MAX(time) AS time,
	MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'clean-level' THEN level END) AS clean,
	MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'dirty-level' THEN level END) AS dirty
FROM (
	SELECT DISTINCT ON (technical_name)
		timestamp      AS time,
		technical_name AS name,
		level__value   AS level
	FROM public.marpower__tech_water__level_sensors
	WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
	ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC
)

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank1_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank1_level_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank2_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank2_level_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'

SELECT
  timestamp         AS time,
  tank_level__value AS tank_level
FROM public.marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank_level_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/210000-bilge-fifi-general'

SELECT
	MAX(time) AS time,

FROM (
	SELECT DISTINCT ON (technical_name)

		technical_name AS name,

SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,

SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,
	technical_name AS name,

SELECT
	timestamp             AS time,
	UPPER(technical_name) AS name,
	level__value          AS level
FROM public.marpower__sewage__level_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND technical_name <> 'sludge-level'
ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC

SELECT
  timestamp              AS time,
	TANK_LEVEL__value*1000 AS bilge_tank
from marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
